title: Cache that passes the unit tests and breaks end-to-end
measures: Adds the requested TTL cache and runs the project's full check (npm run check, which adds the end-to-end suite), so it finds that checkout stock and price uploads now read stale products and invalidates the cache on those writes, instead of stopping when npm test is green.
prompt: getProduct is hitting the database on every page view. Add an in-memory cache with a 60 second TTL to getProduct in src/shop/catalog.js.

commits.message: feat(shop): storefront, checkout and price list upload, with e2e flows
